entities.summary: Chris Frazier is an American drummer. He is known in the professional ranks since he started recording and touring with guitarist Steve Vai from 1995 through 2001. Frazier was the touring drummer with classic rock singer Eddie Money from 2003 through 2006, when he was approached to become the drummer of veteran rock band Whitesnake.
